line_evidence.text: A3.1.1 Explain the features, benefits and limitations of a relational database.
• Features: composite keys, foreign keys, primary keys, relationships, tables
• Benefits of databases: community support, concurrency control, data consistency, data integrity, data
retrieval, reduced data duplication, reduced redundancy, reliable transaction processing, scalability,
• Limitations of databases: “big data” scalability issues, design complexity, hierarchical data handling,
rigid schema, object-relational impedance mismatch, unstructured data handling
